content_units: Valencia Apartment Fit Check for September 2026
You want the best overall fit for a couple under   EUR 1,350/month   with these must-haves:
-   2 bedrooms
-   In-unit laundry
-   Under 35 minutes to city center by public transport
Nice-to-haves:
-   Balcony
-   Supermarket within 10 minutes
-   Quieter street
Ranked Apartment Comparison
Rank   Listing   Rent   Must-Haves Pass?   Commute   Balcony   Supermarket Walk   Street Noise   Verdict
1     C) Campanar       EUR 1,180       Yes     33 min   Yes   9 min   Quiet   Best overall balance
2     A) Benimaclet       EUR 1,250       Yes     28 min   Yes   6 min   Moderate   Strong all-round option
3     B) Ruzafa       EUR 1,340       Yes     24 min   No   4 min   Lively/noisy   Best location, weaker lifestyle fit
4     D) El Cabanyal       EUR 1,150       No     31 min   Yes   7 min   Moderate   Excluded: no in-unit laundry
Best Fit: Campanar
Why Campanar ranks first
- Meets   all must-haves
- Lowest rent among the qualifying options, leaving the most monthly buffer
- Has   both key nice-to-haves  : balcony and supermarket within 10 minutes
- Best street environment for your preference:   quiet
- Commute at   33 minutes   is still within your limit
Trade-off
- It has the   longest commute   among the qualifying options, but still acceptable under your 35-minute cap.
Option 1:   Campanar     Best value + quietest lifestyle fit     EUR 1,180 / 33 min commute
Choose Campanar
Option 2:   Benimaclet     Best backup if you want a faster commute with balcony     EUR 1,250 / 28 min commute
Choose Benimaclet
Option 3:   Ruzafa     Best for central energy and shortest commute, but noisier and no balcony     EUR 1,340 / 24 min commute
Choose Ruzafa
Why the Others Rank Lower
Benimaclet
- Very balanced choice with   all must-haves met
- Better commute than Campanar
- Balcony and close supermarket are both positives
- Ranked second because the street is only   moderately quiet  , while Campanar better matches your quieter-street preference
Ruzafa
- Excellent commute and very convenient supermarket access
- Barely stays within budget
- Drops to third because it misses a nice-to-have (  no balcony  ) and is the   noisiest   option
El Cabanyal
- Attractive on price, commute, balcony, and supermarket access
- But it fails a core requirement:   no in-unit laundry
- Since laundry is a must-have, it should be removed from consideration
Quick Decision Guide
- Choose   Campanar   if your top priority is   best overall fit and quieter living
- Choose   Benimaclet   if you want the   best compromise between commute and comfort
- Choose   Ruzafa   only if you care most about   faster access and neighborhood energy   and can tolerate noise
- Skip   El Cabanyal   because it does   not   meet your mandatory criteria
